forbidden.name: domain-does-not-import-other-layers
forbidden.comment: The domain imports nothing from the application, infrastructure, HTTP or the composition root.

forbidden.name: application-does-not-import-outward
forbidden.comment: The application imports the domain and its own ports. It does not import infrastructure, HTTP or the composition root.

forbidden.name: infrastructure-depends-inward
forbidden.comment: Infrastructure depends inward. It does not import HTTP or the composition root.

forbidden.name: http-depends-inward
forbidden.comment: HTTP depends inward. It does not import infrastructure or the composition root.

forbidden.name: only-composition-root-outside-the-layers
forbidden.comment: Every source module lives in a layer. src/main.ts is the only composition root, so no other src/*.ts module may exist.

forbidden.name: no-circular-dependencies
forbidden.comment: Layers depend inward and do not form a cycle.
